headline: The re-frozen replay gate passes (control 33.5% upper bound against 30%), but the bound assumes the user acts at the 200k crossing: in the one session with a recorded compaction the user compacted 327 turns later, so the realized saving is unmeasured and the A/B (P3) has not run. Top suggestion: scope artifactDir to the experiment folder and raise staleTurns before any A/B, because a broad artifact folder gives 32 stale notes in one session.
